The figure presents two line plots, labeled (a) and (b), which illustrate the inference time measured for baseline Llama models and distilled Mamba and MambaInLlama models at the 1B and 3B scale.

The x-axis represents the batch size, with a linear scale, labeled, and a value range of 1 to 512, with units not shown. The tick labels are 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 512, spaced irregularly.

The y-axis represents the inference time in seconds, with a linear scale, labeled, and a value range of 0 to 10 for plot (a) and 0 to 30 for plot (b). The tick labels are spaced irregularly.

For plot (a), there are three lines: Llama-1B (blue, solid, no markers), Llama-1B (orange, solid, no markers), and MambaInLlama-1B (red, solid, no markers). The Llama-1B line starts at approximately 3.6 seconds and ends at approximately 4.7 seconds. The Llama-1B line starts at approximately 3.4 seconds and ends at approximately 3.7 seconds. The MambaInLlama-1B line starts at approximately 2.6 seconds and ends at approximately 3.7 seconds.

For plot (b), there are three lines: Llama-3B (blue, solid, no markers), Llama-4B (orange, solid, no markers), and MambaInLlama-3B (red, solid, no markers). The Llama-3B line starts at approximately 7 seconds and ends at approximately 23 seconds. The Llama-4B line starts at approximately 6 seconds and ends at approximately 20 seconds. The MambaInLlama-3B line starts at approximately 4 seconds and ends at approximately 10 seconds.
